title: A/P Summary Totals equal A/P Detail's Open Balance, bucket by bucket
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The organization has open documents in these reports at two locations, {Location-A} and {Location-B}, and you are enrolled at both; {Location-A}'s name comes first in A to Z order.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 and {Location-B} is Staging Lethbridge - 4310.
  • {Vendor-A} has a bill of $1,000.00 at {Location-A} that is not yet due, a bill of $400.00 at {Location-A} 45 days past due and a bill of $300.00 at {Location-B} 15 days past due; {Vendor-B} has a bill of $700.00 at {Location-A} 45 days past due, partly paid $200.00 (open $500.00), and a bill of $250.00 at {Location-A} 100 days past due. Nothing else is open for the two on today's date.
    For example: {Vendor-A} is ZZAUTOTEST DATA-15 Parity One and {Vendor-B} is ZZAUTOTEST DATA-15 Parity Two.
  • Starting screen: A/P Summary (Reports, then "A/P Aging Summary" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu, with {Vendor-A} and {Vendor-B} ticked in the Vendor filter and Past due on Any.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Read the Totals row.
  2. Open A/P Detail (Reports, then "A/P Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu) from the Reports menu in a second browser tab.
  3. In the Vendor filter, tick {Vendor-A}.
  4. Tick {Vendor-B}.
  5. In the Location filter, untick {Location-B}.
  6. Switch back to the A/P Summary tab.
  7. In the Location filter, untick {Location-B}.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the Totals row reads Current $1,000.00, 1-30 Days $300.00, 31-60 Days $900.00 (400.00 + 500.00), 61-90 Days $0.00, 91 And Over $250.00 and Total $2,450.00 (1,000.00 + 300.00 + 900.00 + 250.00).
  • Step 2: A/P Detail opens on today's date with no vendor ticked and Past due on Any.
  • Step 3: {Vendor-A} is ticked.
  • Step 4: both are ticked; each bucket row shows its sums: "91 or more days past due" Open Balance $250.00, "31-60 days past due" Open Balance $900.00 (its Amount reads $1,100.00, the original amounts, which are not compared), "1-30 days past due" $300.00 and "Current" $1,000.00, and "61-90 days past due" has no rows; the Totals row's Open Balance reads $2,450.00: bucket by bucket and in total the same as the A/P Summary Totals in step 1.
  • Step 5: the report narrows to {Location-A}: "1-30 days past due" has no rows any more and the Totals row's Open Balance reads $2,150.00 (2,450.00 − 300.00); the other buckets keep their sums.
  • Step 6: A/P Summary shows, as in step 1.
  • Step 7: the report narrows to {Location-A}: the Totals row reads Current $1,000.00, 1-30 Days $0.00, 31-60 Days $900.00, 61-90 Days $0.00, 91 And Over $250.00 and Total $2,150.00: bucket by bucket the same as A/P Detail in step 5.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11531 (Story 1, Reports open in QuickBooks name order), story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S5-R18a: “For the same as-of date, customer or vendor and Location, with Past due on Any, A/R Summary's Totals equal A/R Detail's Open Balance Totals bucket by bucket, and A/P Summary's equal A/P Detail's. The Detail reports' Amount column holds original amounts and is not compared. With a Past due filter they can differ: a Summary keeps the whole row of a customer or vendor that qualifies (Current and credits included), while a Detail report lists only the invoices or bills that qualify, plus every credit.”
  • S5-R18: “The Totals row always adds up exactly the rows the filters leave (customer or vendor, Past due, Location), on screen on every page, in the PDF and in the CSV. On A/R Collection and A/P Unpaid Invoices this fixes today's Totals row, which ignores the customer or vendor filter.”
  • S1-R5: “A/R Detail and A/P Detail keep their aging buckets in this fixed order: "91 or more days past due", "61-90 days past due", "31-60 days past due", "1-30 days past due", "Current". Inside each bucket, rows open in customer or vendor name order (S1-R2 to S1-R4), ties by document number (S2-R4).”
  • S5-R7: “Choosing locations narrows every row, group, subtotal, total, page count, sort and export to the open documents at those locations. A row belongs to the location of its own document. On A/R: the invoice, credit memo or deposit. On A/P: a bill belongs to the location of the delivery it was received on; a vendor credit from a vendor return belongs to that return's location; any other vendor credit keeps its vendor's location, as today. That is the location the Location column shows.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 1 "Opening order and header sorting" (board Main.dc.html); page 7 "Filters and call list" (board Filters.dc.html). The design's own words:

  • "Buckets stay in fixed order; rows inside each bucket go by vendor name (was most overdue first). S1-R5, S2-R4, S2-R5." (caption of "A/P Aging Detail opens by vendor name")
  • "31-60 days and 91+ days ticked: the chip reads "Past due: 2 ranges" in blue. The Summary lists only customers with an amount in those ranges, at full balances; the Totals row adds up exactly these rows. S5-R15, S5-R16, S5-R17, S5-R18, S5-R19." (caption of "Past due ticked")
  • "Customer picked: the group row shows "Phone:" and, for users with View and Manage AP/AR Data, "Credit term:". The Totals row follows the customer filter. S9-R1, S9-R2, S5-R18. Exports carry the same lines and columns: S9-R3, S3-R5, S3-R8a." (caption of "Call list on A/R Collection")
  • "Inside a bucket, rows open most overdue first. No sortable headers." (caption of "A/P Aging Detail as it opens today")
